sources.finding: Official published 2026 market schedule: 23 November-29 December. Friday 25 December: 10:00-20:00. Other page sections still refer to 2025; use only the explicitly 2026 schedule.

Official page describes 18:00 Christmas Eve closure but no unambiguous 2026 year on retrieved schedule. Europe content retains 18:00 as a planning assumption pending official 2026 confirmation, not a guarantee that markets end for the season on 24 December.

Official date-specific timetable confirms the Prague-to-Amsterdam route on sampled September 2026 departures, not the proposed 31 December 2026 departure. Holiday operation, berth availability, station and journey time remain subject to confirmation.
